messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx and timeout cascade affecting control-plane dependencies. Incident ID CP-BACKFILL-4298. Pager to on-call. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/prod/alerts/CP-BACKFILL-4298

sasha: grabbing pager. I'm seeing gateway 502/504 spikes tied to account-service and org-lookup. Spike begins ~4298765200. Full error stream shows fanout from a job hitting account-service.

leo: logging in. Gateway traces show long synchronous calls to /v1/accounts/lookup from a scheduler job. Heap on account-service increased and connection pool exhausted. Snippet:```
2026-03-15T15:12:07Z account-service WARN pool_exhausted connections=120/120
2026-03-15T15:12:08Z gateway ERROR path=/v1/accounts/lookup upstream=10.55.3.7:504 "upstream read timeout"
```

riley: Support reports multiple customers failing during onboarding flows and key creation. Tickets spiked: ~48 in the last 10m. High-volume customers affected: acct-803, acct-999. Raising severity.

support-bot: Tagged tickets with incident CP-BACKFILL-4298 and alerted CSMs for affected enterprise accounts.

maria: Immediate mitigations proposed: 1) Suspend offending backfill cronjob. 2) Enable lightweight cache for account lookups (serve id and tier only). 3) Increase account-service max connections temporarily and add short-circuit for heavy clients. 4) Add emergency circuit-breaker to gateway to fail fast for downstream 5xx.

sasha: I'll suspend the cronjob. Command:```
kubectl -n infra patch cronjob account-mass-sync -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'```

infra-bot: Cronjob account-mass-sync suspended by sasha at 15:14 UTC.

leo: Scaling account-service now by +3 replicas to relieve connection pressure:```
kubectl scale deploy/account-service --replicas=7 -n prod```

riley: Can we short-circuit account lookup cache from the gateway side? We have a cached minimal profile feature.

maria: Deploying runtime flag to gateway control plane:```
POST https://controlplane-api/flags
{"feature":"account_minimal_cache","value":true, "ttl_s":45}
```

incident-bot: Flag account_minimal_cache=true applied by maria at 15:15 UTC. Auto-expire in 45s unless extended.

leo: Quick metrics: after suspending job + cache flag, 5xx dropped from 14% -> 4.6% in 90s. p95 latency for /v1/accounts/lookup fell from 2.9s -> 340ms.

riley: Support update drafted: "We have implemented a temporary mitigation to reduce errors for account-related requests. Some responses may contain minimal account metadata for a short window. We are actively stabilizing the service." Sending to affected customers.

ops-lead: Good fast moves. But we need to know why backfill ran without respecting concurrency limits. Also confirm if billing/charge paths impacted.

sasha: Billing paths show increased retries but primary gateway throttles kept them mostly successful. I see a few payment gateway transient 502s but no sustained errors.

leo: Adding a gateway-level circuit-breaker to fail fast on repeated 5xx from account-service to avoid retry storms. Envoy patch:```
- host: account-service.prod.svc.cluster.local
  circuit_breakers:
    thresholds:
      - priority: DEFAULT
        max_connections: 200
        max_pending_requests: 100
        max_requests: 200
        track_remaining: true
```

enacted.

maria: Also identified several medium-volume clients that were issuing parallelized lookup patterns. I'm adding a temporary client-level throttle for the next 30m.

incident-bot: Action log: cronjob suspended, account-service scaled, cache short-circuit enabled, envoy circuit-breakers adjusted.

riley: Observability shows error rate now ~3.2% and falling. We'll hold watch for 30m.

ops-lead: Create follow-ups: postmortem ticket, job-scheduler concurrency controls, alerting for pool exhaustion, and customer communication.

sasha: Creating postmortem I-4298-BACKFILL and assigning owners. Also filed A-4298-POOL-EXHAUST for DB/connection pool alerts.

leo: Quick note: connection pool exhaustion was at the account-service, not DB tier. We should add a hard cap on per-job client connections. Filing infra PR.

riley: Support: sending final stabilizing update to customers and scheduling a detailed incident note in 1h.

infra-bot: Incident CP-BACKFILL-4298 marked stabilized at 15:16:39 UTC after <10m of active mitigation. Follow-ups: I-4298-BACKFILL, A-4298-POOL-EXHAUST, I-4298-POSTCOMM.

maria: Leaving handoff to leo who will watch the dashboards for 30m. Thanks team.

leo: Oncall acknowledged. I'll keep the thread open and escalate if 5xx > 2% for 5m. Adding runbook note: always check active cronjobs when control-plane 5xx correlate with sudden fanout.

riley: Support will reconvene with CSMs and post an update to affected enterprise customers at +1h.

incident-bot: Thread closed for paging. Logs and timeline archived to /incidents/logs/CP-BACKFILL-4298.

sasha: :thumbsup:, will follow up on rate limits PR.
